proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: over the algebraic closure, the derivative of [p] is multiplication by p on the tangent space, hence everywhere zero, so [p]^* on function fields kills Omega; taking a p-basis t_1, ..., t_g of k(A), each [p]^*(t_i) is a pth power, producing the subextension with presentation x_i^p = t_i and a factorization of [p] over an affine open through a finite locally free morphism pi_1 over a universal homeomorphism pi_2 of degree p^g; since [p] has degree p^{2g}, pi_1 has degree p^g, so fibres have at most p^g points, and translation-invariance makes this uniform over all base points (source lines 2075-2117)
